acceptance.statement: Tested RC21 and reported it good enough for the first beta.
acceptance.scope: First closed beta; no unreported device, duration, save or race details are inferred.

retained_directed_checks.scope: Legacy/source drive excerpts, source physics on Xbox and PS2, an Outer Ring excerpt, normal-control Drift4312 and URL4701 restart/menu paths. These are not six full races.
retained_inconclusive_attempts: First Outer Ring attempt timed out without final statistics; the same build/data later completed the bounded fixed-step case with frameskip6.
First Drift harness used Circle (look back); the corrected L-button script passed on the same executable.

limits: Extended-memory build; PSP-1000 compatibility and all-device support are not established.
Stable 30 fps throughout the game is not yet established.
Full-career completion and all save/reload paths are not qualified on RC21.
Drag 4401 rivals may become stuck in repeated recovery.
Stability Control On has no implemented effect in this executable; leave it Off.
Drift audio cuts/clicks, pause sound and braking sound still need tester confirmation.
Custom dyno and special presets use the earlier handling path; collisions retain port adaptations.
Materials, visibility, doors, movies and all audio/camera combinations need broader testing.
The original US PS2 disc image has not been independently verified; PAL and other revisions are refused.
